title: What is the future of work?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Which parts of today's working life do you think will look completely different in twenty years?
Will AI mainly replace jobs, change jobs, or create new kinds of jobs?
Which human skills are likely to become more valuable as automation increases?
Should people expect to retrain several times during their career?
What kind of future job would you personally find interesting even if it does not exist yet?
